instruction:
Answer the following question using web search and research tools:

According to the 1990 United States census, what was the total population of the cities in Oklahoma that had at least 100,000 residents according to the 2020 United States census?
stdout:
Based on the 2020 United States Census, there are four cities in Oklahoma with at least 100,000 residents:

| City | 2020 Population | 1990 Population |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| Oklahoma City | 681,054 | 441,154 |
| Tulsa | 413,066 | 364,572 |
| Norman | 128,026 | 80,071 |
| Broken Arrow | 113,540 | 58,043 |

**Total population of these four cities in 1990: 943,840**

**Sources:**
- [Norman, Oklahoma - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norman,_Oklahoma) — 1990 census: 80,071
- [Broken Arrow, Oklahoma - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Broken_Arrow,_Oklahoma) — 1990 census: 58,043
- [Oklahoma City - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oklahoma_City) — 1990 census: 441,154
- [Tulsa - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tulsa) — 1990 census: 364,572
